description: This Java class defines an Android Activity named DensityActivity that demonstrates how different density settings affect bitmaps and drawables. It loads and displays various images with differing scaling behaviors, inflates layouts, and shows usage of resource drawables, including 9-patch images.

classes.name: DensityActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating density-scaled images and drawables, inflating layouts, and rendering bitmaps on canvas.

methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up layouts and adds various image demonstrations.
